text:
I understand your concern, but I need to clarify how the system works. When you want to update an address, I need the specific address details to input into the system. The system doesn't automatically know your new address - I have to manually enter the complete address information (street, city, state, zip, etc.) to make the changes.

For security and accuracy purposes, I cannot make up or guess address information. I need you to provide the complete new address details so I can:

1. Update your default address in your profile
2. Update the shipping address for order #W1092119

This is a standard procedure to ensure address changes are accurate and secure. Could you please provide your new address details so I can help you with these updates?
zh:
我理解您的担忧，但需要向您说明系统的工作原理。当您想要更新地址时，我需要您提供具体的地址详细信息以便输入到系统中。系统不会自动知道您的新地址——我必须手动输入完整的地址信息（街道、城市、州、邮编等）才能进行更改。

出于安全和准确性的考虑，我不能编造或猜测地址信息。我需要您提供完整的新地址详细信息，以便我能够：

1. 在您的个人资料中更新默认地址
2. 更新订单 #W1092119 的配送地址

这是一个标准流程，以确保地址更改准确且安全。您能提供您的新地址详细信息吗？这样我才能帮助您进行这些更新。
